seoTitle: How to Connect UPS to Shopify for Free
metaDescription: Add UPS as a shipping carrier in Shopify at no extra cost by linking your account and configuring rates for faster delivery options.
intro: Adding UPS to your Shopify store gives customers a trusted, reliable shipping option without extra cost when you use Shopify's built-in carrier connections. This guide covers how to enable UPS shipping, connect your account, and set up rates for checkout.

steps.heading: Open shipping settings
steps.body: Go to your Shopify admin's shipping and delivery section to begin adding a new carrier.

steps.heading: Enable UPS as a carrier
steps.body: Select UPS from the list of available carrier options to add it to your store.

steps.heading: Connect your UPS account
steps.body: Link your existing UPS account, or use Shopify's included carrier rates if you don't have your own negotiated account.

steps.heading: Set up shipping rates and labels
steps.body: Configure which UPS services and rates display to customers, and confirm label generation works for your orders.

steps.heading: Manage UPS orders
steps.body: Use your Shopify admin to track and fulfill UPS-shipped orders going forward.

faq.question: Do I need my own UPS account to connect it to Shopify?
faq.answer: Not necessarily — Shopify Shipping includes access to discounted UPS rates without requiring your own negotiated account, though you can also link an existing one.

faq.question: Is connecting UPS really free?
faq.answer: Using Shopify's built-in UPS rates doesn't add extra fees beyond your existing Shopify plan, making it a cost-effective shipping option.

faq.question: Can I offer multiple UPS service levels at checkout?
faq.answer: Yes, you can configure several UPS services, like ground and express, so customers can choose the delivery speed they want.

faq.question: What if UPS rates don't appear at checkout?
faq.answer: Double-check your shipping zones and package dimensions, as incorrect settings are a common reason rates fail to calculate.
